name: Company of Heroes
method: Installed file hashing; bundled Relic Archive.exe directory listing and extraction; direct script inspection. No decompilation or gameplay observation.

analysis.note: Image counts are validated TGA headers, not unique sprites or visual quality checks. RGT textures and RGD attribute internals are undecoded. Model discovery remains incomplete.

extraction.validation: Extracted relative paths and byte lengths checked against bundled archive listings; SHA-256 recorded for every extracted file.
